title: Connect an app
heading: Connect {{name}} to Workloom
willAllow: The app will act as you, with no more access than you have:
scopeRead: Read your workspaces, projects, members, tasks and their fields
scopeWrite: Create and update tasks and their fields, such as Estimation and Fact
redirectNotice: After you approve, Workloom returns you to {{host}}. Approve only if you started this connection there yourself.
revokeHint: You can disconnect the app at any time on the Integrations page.
failed: The connection could not be completed. Start it again from the app.
invalidTitle: This connection request is not valid
invalidDescription: It may have expired or been changed. Start the connection again from the app you are connecting.
